描述_EN: Arashiyama" is a reference to the Hozu Gorge in Arashiyama, Kyoto. At the end of the seventeenth year of the Republic of China (1928), Zhang Daqinian, then an up-and-coming painter, was swimming on the Hozu River with a man named "Wada". In the title poem, Zhang Daqian laments that there was no 'beauty' on the boat, but his purpose of visiting Kyoto was to admire ancient paintings. Also, this 'Wada' may be the director of the Kyoto Museum Imperial Wada Fuyu, the predecessor of the Kyoto Expo.
描述_ZN: 岚山 "是指京都岚山的保津峡。 民国十七年（1928年）末，当时的新锐画家张岱年与一个叫 "和田 "的人一起在保津河上游玩。 在标题诗中，张大千感叹船上没有'美人'，但他到京都的目的是为了欣赏古画。 另外，这个'和田'可能是京都博物馆御赐的主任和田不二雄，也就是京都世博会的前身。
